trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Keenan: My shoes are melting and I couldn't care less. Battle me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Keenan: Now I care about the shoes.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Kassandra: Anyone who has come this far into the mountain is worth my time. Show me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Kassandra: Worth every minute. Go on, the way only gets hotter.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Skylar: Natasha and I have been staring each other down for an hour. You'll do for a warm-up!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Skylar: Some warm-up. I'm cooked.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Natasha: Skylar blinked first, whatever he tells you. Now let me see whether you blink.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Natasha: Not once. I'm impressed.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Chelsey: The moon is a long way from here, and still it pulls on my Pokémon. Can you feel it?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Chelsey: You felt nothing at all, did you? How restful that must be.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Sterling: The sun and this mountain burn with the same fire. So does my team!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Sterling: Burnt out. It happens to suns too, I'm told.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Bird Keeper Krystal: Hot air rises, and my birds ride it right up to the roof of the cave. Watch them dive!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bird Keeper Krystal: They dived. You were just somewhere else when they landed.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Ray: I do my push-ups on the hot rock. A thousand a day! Feel the difference!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Ray: Two thousand a day, starting tomorrow.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Stefan: Nobody gets past the pair of us without a battle. Me first!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Stefan: Past me, then. Jasmin won't be so easy.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Jasmin: One Pokémon is all I brought down here. It has never needed help yet.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Jasmin: Today it needed help. I'll remember that.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Dragon Tamer Drake: My dragons are young yet, and the heat of this mountain is what will bring them on!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Dragon Tamer Drake: Not grown enough. Another summer in here should do it.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Jarrett: Four arms against however many you've brought. I like those odds!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Jarrett: I should have counted first.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Abel: I brought ice into a volcano, and it hasn't melted yet. That's how tough my team is!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Abel: It melted. I ought to have seen that coming.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Monique: Abel talks. I battle. Shall we?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Monique: Short and to the point. I can respect that, even losing.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Veteran Harlan: I saw you coming from the far end of the ledge. An old trainer misses very little.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Veteran Harlan: I saw the loss coming too, a little later than I'd have liked.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Dragon Tamer Kenny: They say a Pokémon sleeps in the heart of this mountain. Mine are wide awake!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Dragon Tamer Kenny: Wide awake, and flat on their backs.
